sentences.en: He retired on a pension at the age of sixty.
sentences.zh: 他六十岁时退休领取养老金。

sentences.en: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, hundred.
sentences.zh: 十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十、一百。

sentences.en: About sixty men from the tribe quickly arrived riding horses.
sentences.zh: 大约有六十名部落男子骑马迅速赶到。

phrases.zh: 六十个（或表示某事物的数量为六十）
